column3: The title says praise of David; Psalm is not a separate word.
The first-person meditation includes both the majestic glory and the wonders.
The remembrance of great goodness is poured forth.
The pronouns change to His mighty deeds and His kingdom rather than Your.
The verse ends with dominion through every generation; the following sentence about faithfulness in words and kindness in actions is not included.
All flesh, rather than every creature, is the explicit expression.
